pages.text: Each tier is unlocked by completing $(bold)any one of five quest paths$(/bold) in your FTB Quests book. You don't need to complete all five — you need to complete one.$(br2)The five paths are: $(bold)Grinding$(/bold) (resource gathering), $(bold)Magic$(/bold) (spellcasting), $(bold)Combat$(/bold) (boss killing), $(bold)Exploration$(/bold) (dimension and biome travel), and $(bold)Engineering$(/bold) (automation).

$(bold)Why Five Paths?$(/bold)$(br2)The pack supports multiple playstyles equally. A player who hates automation should not be forced to build a factory to progress. A player who hates boss fights should not be forced to fight a dragon.$(br2)Completing $(italic)additional$(/italic) paths gives bonus skill points and loot boxes — but it's never required. The speedrun path is one path per tier.

$(bold)The Backup Path$(/bold)$(br2)Players who don't use the quest book can still advance. KubeJS milestone detection watches for key events (boss kills, dimension entries, major crafts) and automatically grants tier access when thresholds are met.$(br2)$(warn)Important:$(/warn) The backup path grants tier access only. It does not grant skill points or loot boxes. Those are quest-book-exclusive rewards.

$(bold)Tier Tokens$(/bold)$(br2)Progression tokens are consumed in the crafting of certain Tier-gated items and as quest rewards. They exist in two forms:$(br2)$(bold)Full tokens$(/bold) — granted by gate quests or found in boss loot.$(br)$(bold)Token fragments$(/bold) — found in structure chests. Collect 5 fragments to craft a full token.$(br2)Tokens are $(italic)not$(/italic) strictly required to advance — completing quest paths advances you automatically.
